method.unit: One team-game per exact unordered passive trio; identical builds on multiple players of that team are counted once.
method.active_grouping: Trio equipped in a player slot with the selected active. Deduplicated within team-game and active.
method.passive_grouping: Trio contains the selected passive. Deduplicated within team-game.
method.outcome: Team wins the recorded game (score reaches six); not a round or individual-player result.
method.ranking: Recent cohort first if at least 8 team-games across 3 teams and no team contributes over 60%; otherwise historical support requires at least 20 team-games, 3 teams, and 2 events. Within tiers, order by the descriptive Wilson lower score, then sample size.
method.limits: Observational associations, not causal counter win rates. Repeated teams, matches, opponents, maps and other builds are correlated. Wilson score is a conservative ordering heuristic, not a cluster-adjusted confidence guarantee. All supplied matches predate OB55 and may use older skill versions.
